messages:
fiona: Heads-up: planning to unpin runtime 2.20 (remove emergency pin) for cohort 'low-mem' in the 03:00-05:00 UTC change window tonight. Patch fixes a slab allocator leak and improves P99 on memory-constrained instances. Any compatibility concerns?

samir: Quick note: a small subset of hosts still use the legacy SDK-collector (1.0.x). That previously caused KV API timeouts when unpinned. We should fail preflight unless SDK >=1.1.0 or mark those hosts as 'manual-review'.

olga: Ops plan:
- 03:15 canary on 3 hosts in us-east, 0.5% traffic, run smoke evals for 10m
- 03:35 ramp to 15% if green, 04:00 full cohort
Rollback triggers: error-rate >1.4x baseline for 5m OR token P95 latency regress >250ms for 10m, or any OOM.

deploybot: [auto] Received unpin request: `unpin runtime 2.20 -> cohort low-mem`. Scheduling job id: unpin-1791112222. Preflight checks configured: `sdk-compat-check`, `kv-warmup`, `canary-smoke`. Will post status updates during window.

fiona: Also add a post-roll validation: run deterministic prompt set that exercises long prefix generation and a short-memory classification set. If hallucination delta >1% abort.

samir: I'll add a small script to the release branch that enumerates SDKs and returns non-empty if <=1.0.x. Deploybot should skip those hosts and tag them.

olga: Please ensure kv-cache warmup runs before canary push. Cold starts skew the P99. Script snippet in ops/runbooks/kv-warmup.sh.

sre-bot: Baseline snapshot: https://internal/obs/low-mem/baseline-2024-08-01. Alert rules: lm-err-rate, lm-latency, kv-coldstart.

fiona: ok all, ack if you own the action item. I'll flip to ready-for-window after staging dry-run at 23:00 PT.

samir: ack (sdk scan + script)

olga: ack (canary/runbook/kv-warmup)
